- Her cause of death has not been determined yet and remains under investigation
- Shortly before her death, she publicly accused Hack VC of serious workplace pressure and said she had rejected a settlement that would have kept the dispute private 
- She said she planned to release evidence related to the dispute on August 26.
-  Hack VC has disputed her account, and no connection between her allegations and her death has been established
